newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank sets April rediscount rate.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank sets April rediscount rate.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Wednesday it had set the rediscount rate for April at 8.498 percent, lower than the March rate of 9.625 percent.

The rediscount rate applies to loans for exporters and the farm sector. It is adjusted every month and is computed one percentage point below the average 91-day Treasury bill rate of the last auction of a month.
From January 2 to March 26, loans under the Central Bank's rediscounting window reached 1.755 billion pesos, the bank statement said.
About 55.8 percent of the loans went to export financing and the rest to the farm sector, the statement said.
